sandbox_usage.resolution: Successful VM lifecycle logs, second-resolution timestamps

aws_host_usage.average_method: Trapezoidal integration, linearly interpolated run boundaries
aws_host_usage.scope: Whole AWS host gauges, includes worker and host overhead

clariden_usage.training_step_max_rss_scope: Slurm MaxRSS: maximum sampled RSS of one task, not a sum across nodes or GPU VRAM

telemetry_coverage.note: Scheduler ring lost early samples; full-run host gauges and VM concurrency recovered from durable logs

limitations: Host CPU/RAM peaks are 30-second sampled peaks, not continuous maxima
VM hours use acknowledged created/restored/destroyed lifecycle events, not admission queue time
GPU hours measure allocation; utilization percentages were not retained
No optimizer step completion or checkpoint was recorded

notes: model_token_count is generated tokens retained by response masks
response_len includes tool and observation tokens
prompt_len counts retained initial prompts, not every model call
Harbor agent total_tokens retains only the last call; not cumulative
